think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, verify whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that trigger a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto) compared to normal numeric behavior. 4) Classify as 'special knob' only if such sentinel numeric values exist; otherwise classify as not special. 5) If special, record the sentinel value(s) as special_value.
